title: LLMs Homogenize Values in Constructive Arguments on Value-Laden Topics
reasoning: The study investigates how LLMs reframe human arguments on value-laden topics, specifically focusing on homophobia and Islamophobia. It evaluates LLM alignment with moral and religious values using Schwartz’s theory of basic human values and analyzes the impact of religious backgrounds (Hindu, Muslim, Christian, etc.) on value expression and perception.
